title: Sesenti, Seratus Tahun
subject: a cave guide at Gua Tempurung in Perak leading a noisy school group through the limestone chambers, telling them over and over not to touch the stalactites because the oil on their hands stops the stone growing and one centimetre takes about a hundred years
caption: Malay big-band swing, brassy dance-hall style revived by 2020s Malaysian swing and big-band acts. A full brass section of trumpets, trombones and saxophones playing tight riffs and a shout chorus; a walking upright bass; swing ride cymbal with snare fills kicking the brass hits; a stride piano comping between phrases; a clarinet obbligato weaving round the vocal. Live-room big-band recording, natural room reverb, vintage ribbon-mic warmth. Male baritone crooner with quick tour-guide patter, sly and theatrical, band members shouting the answer lines. 168 BPM, B-flat major. Cheeky, brisk and theatrical. No electro-swing beats, no EDM, no trap, no autotune, no rock guitar.
lyrics:
[Intro - brass fanfare, walking bass, ride cymbal]

[Verse 1]
Selamat datang ke Gua Tempurung
Topi keledar, lampu, ikat tali kasut
Yang depan sekali, budak cermin mata
Jangan lari, lantai licin, nanti jatuh bergolek

[Pre-Chorus]
Nampak batu tergantung dari siling?
Berapa lama dia nak panjang? Teka!

[Chorus]
Sesenti, seratus tahun!
Sesenti, seratus tahun!
Setitik air, satu hari, satu cerita
Sesenti, seratus tahun, tangan dalam poket, cikgu pun sama

[Verse 2]
Bilik pertama, bilik kedua
Air menitik atas kepala cikgu
Budak belakang kira guna jari
Sepuluh senti? Seribu tahun! Dia terdiam dulu

[Pre-Chorus]
Batu ni mula tumbuh sebelum moyang kau lahir
Satu sentuhan, minyak tangan, dia berhenti

[Chorus]
Sesenti, seratus tahun!
Sesenti, seratus tahun!
Selfie boleh, sentuh tak boleh, sabar sikit saja
Sesenti, seratus tahun, tangan dalam poket, cikgu pun sama

[Bridge - brass shout chorus, then stops dead]
Matikan lampu, semua diam
Dengar air menitik, satu, dua

[Chorus]
Sesenti, seratus tahun!
Cucu kau datang, baru dia tambah sesenti
Dia tengok batu yang kau tak sentuh
Sesenti, seratus tahun, tangan dalam poket, macam kau sekarang

[Outro - full band hit, clarinet trill, final brass stab]
